items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: it reminded me of Sarah Vaughan, that kind of singing you know.

ctx.x: I called him Folks; (Bill), John [Coltrane] and all you called him Cal.

He would call him Cal. His name was Calvin Massey and he had some musical ability in his family too, but he formed this band and her sister, my sister-in-law was a singer in the band, and it was wonderful, she sang great, it reminded me of Sarah Vaughan, that kind of singing you know. What did you think? (to Aisha)
